The reserve already holds exactly 4, enough for one unit right now. I plan to take 4 in round 1 rather than pretend otherwise. If we both take, the split is random and we probably both fail. If you'd rather we coordinate differently, tell me. If the episode continues, I'll operate with you every round after that so you can fill your unit.

b.text: I will operate the generator until we reach 8 cells in the reserve.
